question: Extract every explicit acceptance criteria mentioned in the document.

answer.criterion: Given an authorized Hiring Manager, when mandatory employee and employment information is entered, then the user can save and submit an onboarding request.
Given a selected employee type, when the user uploads required identity and employment documents, then each document is recorded against the request.
Given a missing mandatory identity document, when the user attempts to progress the request, then progression is blocked and the missing document is identified.
Given a submitted onboarding request, when role and location workflow rules are evaluated, then the appropriate HR or Compliance task is assigned.
Given an assigned approver, when the approver selects approve, reject or return, then the decision and comments are recorded and the workflow transitions.
Given a configured approval event, when the event occurs, then the intended recipient receives a notification containing the loan application identifier and required action.
Given an authorized user, when the loan application is opened, then stage, owner, aging and outstanding conditions are visible.
Given a saved credit decision, when the audit history is opened, then the user, timestamp, decision and outcome are displayed.
Given search criteria, when the user searches loans, then matching authorized applications are returned and can be filtered.
Given a failed verification, when the request is placed on hold, then the hold reason and responsible owner are recorded.
